sys_email_client_template.body_html:
Dear ${individual.forename_in_full}${entity.legal_name},

We are currently reviewing your account as part of our periodic compliance process. To complete this review, we require the following documents:

  • Utility bill: Must be dated within the last 3 months and show your name and address
  • Passport: Must be currently valid with clear photo and signature page
  • National Identity Card: Must be currently valid with clear photo and details
  • Bank Statement: Must cover the last 3 months and show your name and account details

Please provide these documents at your earliest convenience. You can reply to this email with the documents attached or contact your relationship manager directly.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
${current_user.name}
Relationship Manager
